name: NUp1Down
summary: This EA trades based on a consecutive candle counting pattern — it enters a position when N consecutive up candles are followed by a down candle (or vice versa), anticipating either a reversal or continuation. It is a systematic candlestick pattern strategy that opens trades on signal detection without manual intervention.
summary_zh: 该EA基于连续K线计数模式进行交易——当出现N根连续上涨K线后出现1根下跌K线时开仓（反之亦然），预期反转或延续。这是一个系统化的K线形态策略，在信号检测时自动开仓，无需人工干预。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于连续K线计数模式：当市场出现N根连续同向K线（如连续上涨）后，出现1根反向K线时，视为趋势衰竭信号并进场做反转交易。入场条件为：连续N根阳线后出现阴线则做多（或做空反转），连续N根阴线后出现阳线则做空（或做多反转），N为可配置参数。出场条件依赖固定止盈止损，部分版本可能加入移动止损。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面，该EA通常使用简单固定的风险比例，缺少动态调整机制。整体策略逻辑简单直观，属于典型的K线形态反转交易系统，但在强趋势市场中可能频繁逆势亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a consecutive candle counting pattern: when N consecutive directional candles (e.g., N up candles) appear followed by 1 opposite candle, it is interpreted as a trend exhaustion signal and a reversal trade is entered. Entry conditions: after N consecutive bullish candles followed by a bearish candle, a sell (or buy reversal) is placed; after N consecutive bearish candles followed by a bullish candle, a buy (or sell reversal) is placed, with N being a configurable parameter. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with some versions potentially including a trailing stop. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation relative to account equity. Money management is generally simple with a fixed risk ratio, lacking dynamic adjustment mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive, representing a typical candlestick pattern reversal trading system, but it may suffer frequent counter-trend losses in strong trending markets.

parameters.name: N
parameters.description: 连续同向K线数量，触发信号的最少K线根数
parameters.description_en: Consecutive same-direction bars for signal trigger

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 交易时间周期，0为当前图表周期
parameters.description_en: RSI timeframe, 0 for current chart period

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和验证
参数可配置，N值可根据不同市场和周期优化
基于K线形态的反转思路在震荡市场中表现较好
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and verify
Configurable parameters allow N-value optimization for different markets and timeframes
Candlestick pattern reversal approach performs well in ranging markets
cons: 在强趋势市场中频繁逆势交易导致连续亏损
缺少趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡市和趋势市
仓位管理过于简单，没有动态风险调整机制
cons_en: Frequent counter-trend trades in strong trending markets lead to consecutive losses
Lacks trend filter to distinguish between ranging and trending markets
Position sizing is overly simplistic without dynamic risk adjustment mechanism
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如MA或ADX），在趋势市中暂停反转交易或改为顺势交易
加入资金管理模块，根据连续亏损动态调整仓位大小
增加时间过滤和波动率过滤，避免在低流动性或高波动时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA or ADX) to pause reversal trades or switch to trend-following in trending markets
Implement a dynamic money management module that adjusts position size based on consecutive losses
Add time and volatility filters to avoid trading during low-liquidity or high-volatility sessions

risk_points: 缺少趋势过滤器导致在强趋势中逆势亏损
固定止损可能不适应当前市场波动率，在低波动时过宽、高波动时过窄
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter leads to counter-trend losses in strong trends
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to current market volatility — too wide in low volatility, too narrow in high volatility
